content:
António Aguiar Costa – Research, Development and Innovation Director BUILT CoLAB, and Manuel Parente Head of AI BUITL CoLAB, are the Guest Editors of the Special Issue “Decision Support Systems for the Digital Built Environment”, from MDPI, which will be published in 2021.

MDPI is a pioneer in open access format publishing in the academic area, supporting academic communities since 1996. This Special Issue aims to bring together new research and development systems with regard to innovative decision support systems for the built environment, strongly supported by recent digital technologies.

For those interested, the submission of articles is open until June 30, 2021. See more information on the website: www.mdpi.com
